title: Fur & Chocolate
description: Rich chocolate browns anchored by faux fur coats — either dark or cream — paired with flare pants, knee-high boots, a worn leather tote, and soft blush accessories for a luxe yet approachable winter casual look.
occasion: weekend errands, city strolls, casual lunch, winter outings
